name: ISA Multi-Sentence Corpus
description: 10 multi-sentence inputs from CMS-DHS MOA for Wave 1 SBA validation. Tests sentence segmentation, independent parsing, and SentenceCluster construction.

sentences.input: CMS shall allow USCIS to monitor records. USCIS shall report quarterly.
sentences.description: Two independent obligations with shared entity USCIS

sentences.input: CMS will notify USCIS of any violations. USCIS will collaborate with CMS to address matters.
sentences.description: Two commissive obligations — 'collaborate' + 'address' both get DICEs

sentences.input: Both Parties shall comply with limitations. Both Parties shall maintain security.
sentences.description: Identical subject in both sentences — tests coreference IRI stability

sentences.input: CMS agrees to provide data. USCIS agrees to make the SAVE Program available.
sentences.description: Two commissive 'agrees to' patterns — tests multi-word modal

sentences.input: CMS shall provide access to all records. USCIS may request additional records. Both Parties shall comply with applicable federal laws.
CMS will enter into agreements with AEs. CMS will report this Agreement to OMB. CMS will contact the AE to discuss corrective action.
sentences.description: Three commissive obligations — 'contact'+'discuss' and embedded verbs produce 5 DICEs

sentences.input: The person submitted the report. The organization reviewed the report. The committee approved the document.
sentences.description: Three narrative sentences — no modals, no DICEs

sentences.input: CMS shall provide USCIS with data. USCIS shall monitor records.
sentences.description: Pre-SBA this produced ccomp between 'provide' and 'monitor'

sentences.input: CMS shall allow USCIS to monitor and review all records and documents under CMS possession. USCIS shall report quarterly.
sentences.description: Long first sentence with coordination — pre-SBA second sentence attached as ccomp

sentences.input: The Parties will not use the data to extract information. CMS will report this Agreement to OMB.
